description: Mozambique Classified Road Network is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Mozambique. Its tags are cyclones-hurricanes-typhoons, geodata, roads. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-08-26 as the last metadata change. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
